meta.title: Eltropy Product Descriptions
meta.note: Restructured for consistency. Feature wording unchanged from source.

change_log: Updated description for Remote Video Banking, Remote ID Verify
Removed eSign Inclusion from Video Banking
Added descriptions for Eltropy Payments, Consumer Journeys - Departmental

Added Online Banking (Access Softek, Visifi, CU*Answers), Core Payments integrations (Corelation Keystone, Fiserv DNA, Fiserv Portico, Fiserv XP2, Symitar Episys), International Texting, and Hubspot CRM Communication Integration

change_log.change: Added Branded Calling (Twilio Branded Calling) and Branded Texting (RCS-based) to Solutions; features proposed for review.

Populated First Value Moment for 12 Solutions/Integrations from the SAFCU SOW (Branded Calling, Branded Texting, Appointment Management, Lobby Management, AI Virtual Agents - Voice, Secure Chat, AI Virtual Agents - Chat, AI Assistant - Ask Eltropy, Conversation Intelligence - All Channels, Eltropy eSignature, Remote Video Banking, CU*Answers Online Banking Integration).
change_log.author: Prasad Shrotri

named_user_definition: A user with an account in Eltropy is considered a Named User. Named Users are authorized to use any of the Eltropy solutions.

Platform.name: Eltropy Unified Conversations Platform
features: Omni-Channel Management (Text, Secure Chat, Video, Voice+, Office Phone)
Omni-Channel Conversation Thread and Unified Workspace
notes: Channels are not automatically included and will have to be purchased.
Platform.acceptance_criteria: Named users can log in via SSO and manage conversations across the enabled omni-channel workspace, with role-based access and reporting confirmed in production.

Solutions.name: Appointment Management
features: Configure Multiple Services and Branch Locations
Personalized booking Shortcut links from Eltropy's Launcher
Solutions.first_value_moment: 5 Successful Appointments booked by members/prospects and updated on the agents calendar
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: A member books an appointment through a shortcut link, receives a text/email reminder, and the meeting is completed for at least 5 appointments across the configured services/locations.

Solutions.name: All Digital Channels
features: Live Help for website and mobile app (Supported OLB's)

Text Messaging: 1:1 & 1:Many Texting; Secure Document Collection; Opt-In/Opt-Out Management; Reporting & Analytics; Auto Keywords Replies; Content Sharing; One-Time Password Phone Number Verification; vCard Sharing; MMS Support; Text Message Scheduling; PII Prevention and Redaction

Remote Video Banking: Team/Direct/Meeting Links; Conversation Panel with Video Channel; Built-in Patented E-Sign; Document Exchange; Post Call Surveys & Ratings; Allow Multiple Attendees to Join meeting; Chat during Video Meeting; Screensharing (No mobile browser screen sharing); Pre-loaded Content sharing through Slideshare; Support for patented E-Notary (Needs e-Notary Enabled); Text during Video Meeting (Needs Text Messaging Enabled); 100GB Built In Storage
notes: See Appendix for Usage Limitations
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: At least 5 member engagements are completed across the enabled channels (secure chat, text, video) with documents exchanged and reporting visible.

Solutions.name: Co-browse
features: Co-browse from Chat, Video and Phone engagements
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: An agent co-browses with a member from a chat/video/phone engagement with element masking active, and the session is recorded.

Solutions.name: Conversation Intelligence - All Channels
features: Analyze data from Eltropy Secure Chat, Text, Voice and Video Channels
Analyze data from voice recordings from any voice ACD

Solutions.first_value_moment: After a successful completion of 1 full day for Text or Chat or Voice or Video sessions, CI shows the top topics for members called Using CI, management trains the Agents for future improvements.
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: Recorded engagements across channels are transcribed and scored for CSAT/sentiment/adherence, with PII violations and insights visible in the dashboard.

features: Support for data from Eltropy Secure Chat channel

Solutions.acceptance_criteria: Secure chat engagements are scored for CSAT/sentiment/adherence with insights by user/department visible.

Solutions.name: Text Messaging
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: At least 5 two-way text conversations are completed with opt-in/opt-out honored and reporting visible.

Solutions.name: RCS Messaging
features: RCS Message Sending - Support for individual and text Messaging Campaigns on top of Eltropy's current SMS framework
Delivery & Read Receipt Management - Message status tracking and retries
Fallback to SMS - Automatic transition to SMS if RCS is not supported
Branded Messaging - Display sender name, logo, and verification badge
Interactive Elements - Enable quick-reply buttons for suggested actions
Message Analytics & Reporting - Track delivery, open rates, and customer interactions
Compliance - Adherence to TCPA regulations for compliance with opt-in and opt-out
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: An RCS branded message with interactive elements is delivered with read receipts, and falls back to SMS when unsupported.

Solutions.name: Branded Texting
features: Branded Sender Profile - Messages show the credit union's name, logo and verified-sender badge instead of an unknown number
Rich, Interactive Messages - Quick-reply buttons and suggested actions members can tap to respond
Delivery & Read Receipts - Real-time status tracking for every message
Automatic SMS Fallback - Members whose device or carrier doesn't support RCS still receive the message as SMS
Engagement Analytics - Track delivery, read and reply rates across 1:1 and campaign messages
notes: Delivered over RCS; same capability as RCS Messaging.
Brand and sender verification with carriers must be completed before launch.
Solutions.first_value_moment: 5 Successful Text Messages with Brand and Logo
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: A branded message displays the verified business name and logo on a supported device, reports delivery and read receipts, and falls back to SMS where RCS is unsupported.

Solutions.name: Text to Talk
features: Make phone calls from Eltropy Launcher (No Hard Phone needed)
If using Eltropy Conversation Analytics, analyze the recorded calls
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: An agent places and records a call from the Launcher without a hard phone, and the recording is available for playback.

Solutions.name: Video Verify
features: Send Direct Meeting Links to Video Meetings (No Inbound Video Calls)

Solutions.acceptance_criteria: A member's identity is verified in real time (Plaid) with selfie and fraud-ring checks passing, on the enabled channel.

Solutions.name: Voice+
features: Inbound and outbound PSTN Voice Calling
Phone Numbers (New and Existing Number Porting)

Solutions.acceptance_criteria: 5 complete interactions flow AI Voice/IVR to routing to agent with tagging, transcript, and automated QA captured.

Solutions.name: Consumer Journeys - Departmental

Ability to see the Journey performance
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: A collections journey is triggered from the sFTP file and runs a multi-campaign email/text sequence with performance visible.

Solutions.name: Eltropy Payments
features: Ability to accept ACH Payment for Loans Repayment
Ability to accept Debit Cards for Loans Repayment
Ability to accept payment wallets (Apple and Google) for Loans Repayment
Payment Webportal will be made available from Eltropy to be embedded/integrated within the CU Website
Members will be able to make the loan repayment via Web Payment Portal
Settlement Funds: Settlement funds will be sent by NUVEI either to Savings, Checking or GL Account
Solutions.first_value_moment: 5 Payments completed end to end including the GL settlement.
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: 5 loan payments are completed end-to-end (ACH/debit/wallet) with GL settlement confirmed.

Solutions.name: Office Phones
features: Inbound and outbound PSTN Voice Calling
Integration with MS Teams as a Teams App (Optional)
notes: *Roadmap/Beta Features
Solutions.first_value_moment: 5 successful inbound, 5 successful outbound and/or 5 successful transfers without call drop by at least 2-3 users.
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: 5 successful inbound and 5 outbound calls (and/or transfers) are completed without call drops by 2-3 users.

Solutions.name: Eltropy ID Verification

Solutions.name: Eltropy eSignature
features: Support eSignature on Chat, Text, Video (Channel Subscription needed)
Support ability to create, edit and delete templates
Support ability to add multiple documents in same envelope
Support multiple Signers and Signing Order for Signers
Secure download of signed documents for signers
Solutions.first_value_moment: 5 Banking sessions completed where the agent is able to assist the consumer with real E-Signature services to a completed Signature.
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: A multi-document envelope is signed by multiple signers in order, with audit logging and secure download of the signed documents.

Solutions.name: International Texting

Solutions.acceptance_criteria: Successfully send and receive a text to/from a member in a supported international country (Texting SKU enabled).

Solutions.name: Branded Calling
features: Verified Business Name - Display the credit union's approved name (up to 35 characters) on members' phones for outbound calls from Eltropy numbers
Logo & Call Reason - Show the brand logo and a short call reason (up to 64 characters) on supported handsets (Enhanced Branded Calling)
Vetted Caller Profile - Outbound numbers are registered under a verified business profile, helping calls look trustworthy and avoid being ignored as unknown
Works Across Outbound Use Cases - Applies to collections, lending, fraud-alert and service callbacks placed from Voice+ and Office Phones
notes: Powered by Twilio Branded Calling; currently delivered on T-Mobile and Verizon networks.
Logo and call reason display depends on the member's carrier and handset; call reason is not shown on iOS devices.
Business profile and number vetting must be completed before branded calls go live.
Solutions.first_value_moment: 5 Successful calls with Brand and Logo
Solutions.acceptance_criteria: A test outbound call from an Eltropy number shows the approved business name (plus logo and call reason on a supported handset) on a T-Mobile or Verizon device.
